instance_configuration.structure: Single-depot closed Euclidean CVRP; uniform, clustered, and mixed coordinates; demand/capacity ratio controlled by generation rather than seed alone.

instance_configuration.qualification_gate: explicit fleet-size multiple and vehicle-limit verification implemented; references imported; solver Base/headroom qualification pending

instance_configuration.structure: Single-depot closed VRP with integral time windows and service times; generate wide, medium, and tight windows as separate cells, including spatially correlated and uncorrelated windows.
instance_configuration.reference_and_semantic_check: Independently verify capacity, arrival/service timing, waiting, and depot horizon. Keep infeasible generation diagnostics; do not silently regenerate until feasible.
instance_configuration.qualification_gate: integer-window generator and verifier implemented; VROOM solver path qualification pending

instance_configuration.structure: Single-depot closed routing; compare 2 vehicle types (capacities 40/80, fixed costs 0/20) with 3 types (30/60/100, fixed costs 0/10/30). Customer demand must make type choice relevant.

independently verify feasible witnesses and objectives

execution.parallelism_policy: Use all healthy available worker capacity subject to disk space and current host load; do not fill nodes with existing disk pressure.
